events.title: Possible Solar Eclipse Recorded in Medieval Chronicles
events.description: Some medieval sources are associated with astronomical observations around this date, though this entry is uncertain and should be treated cautiously.
events.significance: Illustrates how medieval chroniclers documented celestial phenomena, though the specific date is not firmly established.

events.title: Marriage of Henry VIII and Catherine of Aragon
events.description: Henry VIII married Catherine of Aragon, the widow of his elder brother Arthur, at Greenwich on June 11, 1509, shortly before their joint coronation.
events.significance: The eventual annulment dispute over this marriage led Henry to break with the Roman Catholic Church and establish the Church of England, reshaping English religion and politics.

events.title: Captain Cook's Endeavour Runs Aground on the Great Barrier Reef
events.description: During his first voyage of exploration, James Cook's ship HMS Endeavour struck a coral reef off the coast of Queensland, Australia, and was seriously damaged. The crew lightened the ship and managed to refloat it, then repaired it at the site of present-day Cooktown.
events.significance: The incident was a major episode in Cook's exploration of Australia's east coast and highlighted the dangers of navigating the Great Barrier Reef.

events.title: Thích Quảng Đức Self-Immolation Photographed
events.description: The Buddhist monk Thích Quảng Đức burned himself to death at a busy Saigon intersection to protest the persecution of Buddhists by the South Vietnamese government of Ngô Đình Diệm. Malcolm Browne's photograph of the act circulated worldwide.
events.significance: The images shocked the world, intensified international criticism of the Diệm regime, and contributed to the loss of U.S. support that preceded his overthrow later that year.

events.title: Birth of Jacques Cousteau
events.description: Jacques-Yves Cousteau, the French naval officer, explorer, and filmmaker, was born on June 11, 1910, in Saint-André-de-Cubzac, France.
events.significance: Co-developer of the Aqualung and creator of acclaimed ocean documentaries, Cousteau greatly advanced underwater exploration and popularized marine conservation.
